newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romanian parliament's lower Chamber of Deputies rejected a simple motion lodged by opposition deputies against the government job cuts policy in the health, farming, education and justice sectors.
The motion said the job cuts jeopardised Romania's public health and education.

* Senators from the opposition Party of Social Democracy and National Unity Party took stand in the Senate on Tuesday to demand that the ruling Democratic Convention bloc withdrew from the government due to what they called "failure to keep its electoral promises comprised in the bloc's 200-days contract with Romania".

* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea is scheduled to hold a press conference at 1830 hours local to present the state of reform in Romania and the country's macro-economic situation after signing loan agreements with the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank.
The national radio plans a live broadcast of the event.

* Romanian President Emil Constantinescu and his Hungarian counterpart Arpad Goncz are expected to arrive in the Transylvanian city of Targu-Mures in the afternoon. The two have visited Cluj earlier in the day.
